meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Google Maps scraper for lead generation. Turns a business type and a place into a clean CSV of local businesses by driving the kit's own Google Maps engine, running locally (with Python and a headless Chrome, or in Docker) as a REST API on localhost:8080. Returns 8 lead fields by default (name, phone, email, website, category, address, rating and review count), plus social profiles by default (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X; `--no-socials` skips them), row filters such as businesses without a website, or all 36 raw fields. Use when the user wants a lead list, "a list of [businesses] in [place]", local business data, contact enrichment for places (emails, phones, socials), or a whole-city run past Google's ~120 results per search. Do not use for scraping Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or any other social media platform directly.
